department: Department of Civil and Systems Engineering

deadline.value: The PhD deadline for fall is December 31 (year inferred); late applications are not accepted.

app_fee.value: The department's PhD fee is USD 25; waivers are requested in the application.
app_fee.quote: Our Department offers a reduced fee ($25) for the PhD program and no fee for the Master’s programs.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for PhD applications.
gre_general.quote: The Whiting School of Engineering does not require GRE General Test scores for applications to our PhD programs.

english_waiver.value: Whiting School of Engineering sets the English-test waiver rule and the page listing it could not be fetched, so the Krieger rule is not shown for Civil and Systems Engineering.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to work with a specific advisor named in the offer letter; do not email faculty to ask about openings.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted to work with a specific advisor, the faculty member, listed in the offer letter.

funding.value: All PhD students are fully funded with stipend, tuition and insurance while in full-time residence.
funding.quote: all Ph.D. students are fully funded with doctoral funding while they are in a full time, resident status

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree; students from any technical background can apply directly.
entry_route.quote: Students do not need a civil engineering degree to apply - students from all technical backgrounds are welcome.

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not state the GRE Subject test.
